title: Buyer - GCG Custom Engineered Solutions
description:
Overview
GCG Custom Engineered Solutions is currently seeking a Buyer to join the Custom Engineered Solutions procurement team!
As a Buyer with our procurement team, you will be responsible for planning and purchasing the raw materials needed to support our cable assembly operations. You’ll play a key role in ensuring materials are available to meet production demand while maintaining appropriate inventory levels, cost control, and supplier performance.
This role requires close coordination with internal teams and suppliers to manage demand signals, execute purchase orders, and maintain a steady flow of materials through the operation. Your work will directly support on-time delivery and overall operational efficiency.
Schedule: Monday-Friday, 7:00am to 4:00pm EST
What You’ll Do
Procurement Execution & Order Management

• Manage purchase orders from requisition through receipt, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and alignment with production requirements

• Procure raw materials, MRO, and services at optimal cost, quality, and lead time

• Monitor open orders and proactively manage delivery schedules to prevent shortages or disruptions

Material Planning & Inventory Management

• Review MRP outputs in Oracle to plan and maintain appropriate inventory levels for assigned commodities

• Establish and adjust safety stock levels in alignment with production needs and business objectives

• Balance inventory investment with service level expectations to support efficient operations

Supplier Management & Sourcing

• Source and evaluate suppliers, obtain quotations, and negotiate pricing and lead times

• Build and maintain strong supplier relationships to support reliability and continuous improvement

• Participate in supplier performance reviews and support corrective actions as needed

Operational & Cross-Functional Support

• Partner with production, engineering, and supply chain teams to align material availability with manufacturing schedules

• Resolve material issues including shortages, quality concerns, and supplier discrepancies

• Support cost reduction initiatives and process improvements across the procurement function

• Maintain accurate data and transaction integrity within ERP and procurement systems

What You’ll Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, or related field preferred

• 3-5 years of experience in a purchasing, buyer, or materials planning role within a manufacturing environment

• Experience working with MRP/ERP systems (Oracle strongly preferred)

• Strong understanding of material planning, inventory control, and procurement processes

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, production-driven environment

• Effective communication and negotiation skills with both internal teams and external suppliers

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and standard business applications

• Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy, follow-through, and problem-solving

What We Offer

• Competitive base salary ranging from $60,000 to $65,000, dependent on relevant experience

• Comprehensive health coverage with multiple plan options (CDHP and PPO)

• Company-paid life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, supplemental insurance options

• Generous time off including PTO, paid holidays, parental leave, and compassionate care leave

• Wellness and support programs (EAP, wellness incentives, telehealth)

• Extras including dental/vision, FSAs/HSAs with company contributions, pet insurance, legal services, and ID theft protection

• An employee-centric culture that values and truly appreciates our most important asset: You!

Our Use of AI in Recruiting

title: Nurse Practitioner - ADHD Diagnosis and Treatment (Kansas)
description:
Who are we, and why should you join us?

ADHDAdvisor.org is on a mission to remove the conventional barriers to ADHD diagnosis and treatment and make mental health care more accessible to everyone, no matter where they live. Our telehealth platform--was founded to integrate technology, clinical expertise, and progressive approaches to emotional wellness.

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for Kansas licensed Nurse Practitioners to join our provider network. You can focus on providing clinical expertise while we care for everything else. Nurse Practitioners must be able to diagnose and prescribe independently. Kansas license and DEA required.

Who Should Apply?

• Nurse practitioners looking for an easy, all-in-one technology platform for telehealth.

• Nurse practitioners who are experienced in prescribing stimulant and non stimulant medication when necessary and following federal and state laws.

• Nurse practitioners who want to focus 100% on clinical work - not on acquiring clients, billing, support, or operations. (We handle all of that!)

What You'll Do

• Provide holistic mental healthcare to your patients including diagnostic and medication management.

• Develop and implement treatment plans tailored to your patient's needs and follow the best practices and clinical guidelines.

• Collaborate with our team of mental health professionals to ensure that your patients receive comprehensive, coordinated care.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records following legal and ethical standards.

• Help shape our treatment philosophy and contribute to developing clinical policies and procedures.

Requirements

• Active and unrestricted license in Kansas (required).

• Active Kansas DEA license (required).

• Currently carry (or be willing to obtain) independent malpractice liability insurance.

• Experience diagnosing and treating adult ADHD (ages 18+) .

• Experience prescribing medication, preferably on a telehealth platform.

• A private and professional environment for conducting sessions.

• Excellent written communication.

• Reliable Internet connection.

• Currently residing in the US.

Benefits

•
Flexible schedule : You’re always in control of your schedule and appointment times.

•
Location : We are fully remote - you can work anywhere in the US.

•
License reimbursement: We pay for your license in states where we face a high demand.

•
Minimum bureaucracy: We handle operations and ongoing client support.

•
Visibility : We regularly work with leading mental health online publications (Forbes, Ver Well Mind, etc.) to feature articles or case studies written by our team members.

Hourly Pay: $120

• Diagnosis + Medication Management (45 minutes): $90

• Medication Management (30 minutes): $60

• Medication Management Follow-Up (15 minutes): $30

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Risk Engineering
description:
WHO WE ARE

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com http://Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

Risk Engineering owns the systems that execute Imprint's risk decisions in real time: transaction authorization and fraud scoring on every card swipe, the underwriting pipeline that evaluates every application, and the vendor integrations that power both. These are latency-sensitive, high-stakes distributed systems with a sprawling surface area and many stakeholders competing for the team's capacity. AI has made execution faster; the differentiator is the judgment to decide what to build, how to sequence it, and when to say no. That judgment, applied to a strong team and a hard domain, is what this Senior Engineering Manager owns.

THE OPPORTUNITY

- Own real-time authorization and fraud decisioning: Every card swipe runs through systems your team builds. Decisions happen in milliseconds, failures are visible immediately, and a wrong answer costs real money in either direction: fraud losses on one side, declined good customers on the other. You set the bar for how these systems are designed, tested, and operated.

- Own the underwriting pipeline: Every application Imprint receives is evaluated by the pipeline your team owns, spanning credit, fraud, identity, and compliance checks. As Imprint launches new brand partners and new products, the pipeline has to absorb new policies and new data sources without becoming brittle.

- Make vendor decisions that hold up in production: Fraud scoring, identity verification, and bureau data all run through third-party integrations. You'll evaluate vendor capabilities, weigh build-versus-buy with real latency and cost numbers, and push back on approaches that won't survive production load.

- Prioritize across a wide surface cross-functional surface area: Credit, Fraud, Product, and Compliance all have legitimate asks and compete for the same engineering capacity. You'll bring clarity to poorly-scoped platform problems, decide what the team does and does not take on, and make the reasoning legible to stakeholders who didn't get what they asked for. You define the roadmap and scope the work yourself; nothing is abstracted through organizational layers.

- Lead with technical credibility, amplified by AI: AI has collapsed the distance between management and IC work. Managers at Imprint use AI tools to investigate codebases, assess the complexity and viability of work, and bring clarity to ambiguous asks. You don't need to be on the critical path writing code (though some managers are), but you need the technical judgment to evaluate design trade-offs on latency-sensitive distributed systems and the modern tools to exercise it.

- Lead a strong team as a craft: You inherit a strong, psychologically safe team of senior engine

title: Product Manager, Payments Infrastructure
description:
Who We Are

Yellow Card is the largest licensed Stablecoin-based infrastructure provider operating across over 60 countries. From Stablecoin payment infrastructure to fiat settlement rails, wallet services, and custom local Stablecoin issuance, Yellow Card provides the complete infrastructure businesses need to manage Stablecoins, payments, and operations across 50 emerging markets.

Yellow Card operates with a substantial global team spanning 24 countries. This workforce is characterized by its linguistic diversity, with collective speaking of over 25 languages, underscoring the company’s extensive international reach.

About the Role

The Product Manager, Payments Infrastructure, will be responsible for the underlying rails, systems, and integrations that move money through Yellow Card's platform. Working closely with the Payment Experience PM, who designs how customers interact with payments, you'll own the infrastructure that makes those experiences possible: settlement rails, ledger systems, banking and liquidity partner integrations, and multi-currency processing at scale.

You will be the voice of reliability, scalability, and correctness for every payment that moves through Yellow Card. You'll own how transactions are processed, settled, and reconciled under the hood - from initiation through to funds landing in the right place, in the right currency, on time. Your focus is ensuring the payment infrastructure is resilient, fast, and able to scale across Yellow Card's markets and multiple banking and Stablecoin rails.

As the subject matter expert for payments infrastructure, you'll work closely with engineering on system architecture trade-offs, partner with Compliance and Treasury on regulatory and liquidity requirements, and represent infrastructure capabilities and constraints to the rest of Product. This role requires deep technical fluency in payments systems, strong engineering collaboration skills, and the ability to make sound trade-offs between speed, cost, and reliability.

What You’ll Do

Duties include, but are not limited to:

Payments Infrastructure Roadmap

• Own the technical roadmap for core payment processing infrastructure: rails, ledger, settlement engine, and currency conversion

• Own the execution of the Virtual accounts strategy for the organization  

• Partner with the Payment Experience PM to translate infrastructure capabilities into customer-facing features, and to surface upcoming experience needs back into the infrastructure roadmap

• Evaluate and prioritize new banking, liquidity, and Stablecoin rail integrations based on cost, speed, and market coverage

• Define infrastructure investment priorities: where to build for scale now versus later

Core Payment Systems

• Own the ledger and transaction processing systems that record and reconcile every payment

• Own settlement logic across banking partners, liquidity providers, and Stablecoin rails (USDC, USDT, PYUSD)

• Own multi-currency conversion and routing logic, including selecting the optimal rail per transaction

Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research

Each of our HSCs handle over 40 million parcels annually, with our largest site measuring more than 300,000 sq ft.

You will also be accountable for whether the site is measurably better in a month than it is today for each of our key metrics. You are on the floor for your shift, every shift. - Stay decisive through volume peaks, outages, and labour gaps. Triage, solve the problem at hand quickly, contain the impact, restore flow

- Present and write clearly whether briefs, escalations, handovers or post-incident reviews. Decisions here get made based off what you wrote

- Implement changes into a live operation such as introducing robotics, launching new sortation tech or onboarding new clients. We are changing the operations constantly which means you’ll roll change out mid flight and bring your team along the journey.

Who you are

- Scaled something from zero: a site, a market, a process or a program.

- Managed a physical operation: quick commerce, grocery, e-commerce fulfillment, last mile, 3PL, food production, airport ground handling, rail. Anywhere with a hard cut off and people on the floor.

- Communicate in both directions and have strong people management skills: you can brief 80 operatives at shift start and take a problem to senior leadership the same day.

- Built a mechanism that held: a control, a cadence, a metric, a document standard. Something you authored that changed how frontline teams worked.

- Own numbers rather than report them: you can name a metric you created or redefined, explain why the previous one was wrong, and say what changed afterwards.

- Understand frontline work: one of these must be true: you have personally led frontline teams; you have worked embedded in and around a frontline population day to day, without the reporting line; or you have been accountable for outcomes delivered by frontline people you did not employ.

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

title: Security Engineer, Exposure and Vulnerability Management
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE SECURITY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door.

- Build the entire security program from scratch. Most leaders inherit someone else's system and spend a career patching it. Here you own it end to end, bare metal to boardroom, as we scale across continents.

- Your threat surface is measured in gigawatts. The customers running on our infrastructure are building the most consequential technology in human history, and being responsible for the physical and logical security of that work makes everything else feel small.

ROLE SCOPE

- Own exposure and vulnerability management across the estate: external attack surface, cloud and Kubernetes, corporate endpoints, network infrastructure, and the bare-metal fleet beneath them.

- Extend exposure and vulnerability management across the corporate fleet (macOS, Windows, Linux): OS and application patch posture, first-party and third-party software, and drift from approved baselines.

- Cover software outside our managed and approved catalogs: unmanaged apps and SaaS, package-level software on endpoints (npm, PyPI, Homebrew), and browser and IDE extensions. Identify it, assess it, and drive it to remediation or removal.

- Build the engineering that makes it work: asset inventory, scanner orchestration, deduplication, and prioritization built on reachability and real-world exploitation rather than raw CVSS.

- Engineer remediation into the workflows teams already use, so findings land as owned tickets, fixes ride existing pipelines, and closure verifies automatically.

- Remediate alongside the teams that own the systems: write the patch PR, harden the base image, fix the IaC module, and ship the config change rather than just requesting it.

- Extend the program past where enterprise playbooks run out: BMC and device firmware, GPU drivers, host images at fleet scale, and the long tail of data center equipment.

- Run intake for pen test findings and external reports, and report exposure honestly: what's reachable, what's exploited in the wild, what's accepted and by whom.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

description: This is an Atlantic portfolio venture. About the Venture AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up. Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around. We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task. Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one. Our founder brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. title: Payments Risk Analyst
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

 

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

 

We’re looking for an experienced Payments Risk Analyst based in Belfast to join our Global Risk team. In this role you will independently manage less-defined and more complex risk work while contributing to team projects and operational improvements. This role builds on Analyst I capability by recognising patterns, expanding findings, suggesting solutions, and applying sound judgement with minimal direction.

 

What you’ll be doing:

Reporting to the Risk Operations Lead, you will be responsible for daily monitoring within multiple risk queues along with various operational tasks including but not limited to:

- Manage complex transaction, merchant, onboarding, fraud, credit, and compliance cases across risk queues, owning end-to-end assessments using merchant,business, account, transaction, and other risk signals.

title: Co-op, Mechatronics Engineer
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila is seeking a Co-op, Mechatronics Engineer to join the Hardware & Controls Engineering team in Alewife for the January through May term. You will work on the systems that make autonomous science possible: automated workcells, custom instrumentation, sensing hardware, motion systems, and integrated lab equipment.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who wants to build real hardware in a fast-moving R&D environment. You will move between mechanical design, electrical integration, prototyping, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting, working alongside engineers and scientists to turn lab needs into reliable engineering systems.

Your work will support the next generation of lab automation at Lila, helping improve the reliability, scalability, and performance of systems used across our scientific programs. You will leave the term with practical experience across the full mechatronics stack, from concept and CAD through build, test, and iteration.

What You'll Be Building

• Design and build mechanical and electromechanical components for automated lab systems.

• Support integration of sensors, actuators, motion systems, and control hardware.

• Create CAD models, drawings, prototypes, fixtures, and test setups.

• Assemble, debug, and iterate on hardware for workcells and custom instrumentation.

• Run tests, document results, and communicate design changes clearly.

• Collaborate with engineers and scientists to translate lab workflows into reliable systems.

• Contribute to improvements that increase system reliability, usability, and maintainability.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Currently pursuing a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related field.

• Experience with CAD design, prototyping, fabrication, or hands-on engineering projects.

• Foundational understanding of mechanical systems, electrical systems, sensors, actuators, or controls.

• Comfortable building, testing, debugging, and documenting physical systems.

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail in hands-on technical work.

• Clear communication skills and ability to collaborate across engineering and scientific teams.

• Curiosity about lab automation, instrumentation, robotics, or autonomous science.

Bonus Points For

• Experience with SolidWorks or another parametric CAD tool.

• Exposure to electrical wiring, instrumentation, controls, or data acquisition systems.

• Experience with robotics, lab automation, industrial automation, or motion systems.

• Familiarity with 3D printing, machining, sheet metal, or rapid prototyping methods.

• Previous internship, co-op, lab, project team, or R&D experience.

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy .

Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Everpure (formerly Pure Storage) is hiring a Senior Pre-Sales Systems Engineer to support our Higher Education business, with a focus on R1 research universities.

R1 institutions are not one customer. A single campus can behave like a dozen different organizations at the same time: central IT running enterprise applications, research computing and HPC teams, genomics and imaging cores, AI and machine learning labs competing for GPU time, an academic medical center with its own rules and its own budget, and faculty groups buying infrastructure directly with grant money. Decisions move through CIOs, research computing directors, principal investigators, sponsored programs offices, procurement, and consortium contract vehicles, often in parallel and not always in agreement.

That environment rewards someone who can hold a lot of context at once, translate between very different audiences, and connect technology to the outcomes these institutions actually care about: time to result for researchers, compliance with sponsor and grant requirements, data that stays usable for a decade or more, and budgets that have to stretch further every year.

You will be the technical lead on these accounts, working alongside account managers, specialists, and partners to build solutions customers can defend internally, both technically and financially.

Location: Michigan or Indiana

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Develop a real understanding of what drives each institution: research priorities, funding cycles, capital versus operating constraints, and who actually makes the decision

• Connect technology, including the Everpure portfolio and the broader ecosystem, to measurable research and institutional outcomes

• Move fluently between principal investigators, research computing staff, central IT, CIOs, finance, and procurement, adapting the conversation to each audience instead of delivering the same presentation

• Build the business case alongside the technical one: total cost of ownership, power and cooling, data center footprint, staff time, and the real cost of the current environment

• Support research workloads end to end, from instrument and sequencer output through HPC and AI pipelines to long-term retention and archive

• Help customers work through data management questions: lifecycle and retention, reproducibility, sponsor and funding agency data sharing expectations, research data governance, and security requirements such as NIST 800-171 and CMMC where they apply

• Partner closely with account managers, specialists, channel partners, and higher education purchasing consortia and contract vehicles

• Take ownership of evaluations, benchmarks, proofs of concept, and system configurations, and secure the technical win

• Capture requirements and translate them into solutions that help institutions grow their research capability rather than just their capacity

• Author responses to RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs, which in this segment are frequent and detailed

• Stay current on the competitive landscape and make sure our positioning reflects it honestly

• Follow market and research computing trends closely enough to bring that thinking back into our organization

• Lead by example living the Pure Values: Persistence, Creativity, Teamwork, Ownership and Customer-first

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Required

• 8 or more years of relevant experience across technology, solution design, and customer-facing communicatio

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:
At BrightBee , we're on a mission to solve the critical K-12 staffing crisis by connecting schools with the vital support staff they need to thrive.
We look beyond the traditional classroom to empower the unsung heroes of education - the paraprofessionals, front desk assistants, afterschool group leaders, and operational support staff who keep schools safe and running smoothly. Through our flexible technology platform we provide schools and youth-serving organizations with on-demand coverage, permanent placements, and hosted workforce solutions, ensuring that no classroom or student is left without a champion.
About the Role
We’re looking for an SDR who has lived the reality of working in schools. This role is the front door of our sales motion: you’ll open conversations with district HR leaders and their teams, build genuine relationships across district offices, and book qualified meetings for our sales team. Your credibility as someone who has been in the building and understands what it means when a classroom or cafeteria is short-staffed is what will set you apart. This is a phone-first role. You’ll spend most of your day in live conversations, working to generate interest in BrightBee solutions.
What You’ll Do

• Conduct high-volume, high-quality outbound calling to K-12 district HR contacts within assigned territories, supplemented by short, purposeful follow-up emails

• Partner with Sales to develop a strategic, regional approach.

• Develop targeted prospect lists, researching districts, identifying the right contacts, and prioritizing outreach within strategic focus areas.

• Develop authentic relationships with everyone you reach, including front-office staff and administrative gatekeepers, treating every conversation as an opportunity to learn about the district’s staffing needs

• Translate what you hear into concise, personalized follow-up that reflects each district’s specific needs

• Book qualified meetings for Account Executives and own the handoff, including confirmation and reminder touchpoints that drive meeting attendance, not just meeting acceptance

• Track activity, conversations, and pipeline contributions accurately in our CRM

• Share what you’re learning from the field to help refine messaging, targeting, and outreach strategy

What You’ll Bring
Required

• Direct K-12 experience as an educator, paraprofessional, substitute, or school/district staff member. You understand district operations and the daily impact of support staff shortages firsthand

• Genuine comfort and energy on the phone; you’d rather have ten real conversations than send a hundred emails

• Persistence and consistency. You’re energized by daily outreach and building familiarity with contacts over time.

• Strong self-direction: you can take a territory or target list and independently figure out who to call and why

• Clear, simple, communication style, with the discipline to keep messages short and relevant

• Curiosity and respect in every interaction, regardless of the person’s title

Preferred

• Experience selling to or working with school districts

• Prior SDR, BDR, or other outbound experience

• Familiarity with CRM tools and basic prospecting research

W hat Success Looks Like

• Qualified meetings booked, and a strong show rate on those meetings

• Consistent daily call activity that builds name recognition with districts

• A growing network of district contacts who know you and take your calls

• Follow-up that’s personalized, timely, and reflects real listening

Location
Remote: Able to work remotely in the following states: CA, TX, IL, MA, MI, NV, GA, or WY. Must be able to work standard central or eastern timezone business hours.
Compensation
OTE of $70,000-90,000 depending on experience and location, plus full benefits, unlimited PTO, and stock options.

title: Founder's Office, Customer Success (New york)
description:
ABOUT OPTEXITY

Optexity is a product-driven research lab building clinical reasoning and computer use models on data no other lab can reach. We deploy directly inside clinics and hospitals - including systems with no APIs, using integration infrastructure we've built and open-sourced - and in return become their preferred partner. That gives us proprietary clinical reasoning trajectories from practicing physicians, and a feedback loop between real patient encounters, our models, and the products built on top of them.

We're a small, fast-moving founding team with multiple published papers in NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR etc and background from Apple, Amazon, Microsoft, CMU, IIT.

We are backed by world-class investors and leaders like Jeff Dean, Neotribe VC, PearVC, Together Fund and Zapier Fund.

 

HOW WE WORK

- Customer obsession - we start with the customer and work backwards

- Intellectual honesty - ideas matter more than titles; we communicate directly and assume good intent, even in disagreement

- Bias for action - we build and learn with customers rather than debate in the abstract

- Extreme ownership - we own outcomes, not just tasks, and see problems through

About the role

This is not a support role, and not a sales role. It is a flexible, hands-on role for someone who wants to start a company one day. You will be the face of Optexity to our customers: the practices, clinics and doctors who use our product every day. You will sit with them on site, learn how they work, and bring what you learn back to the founders to shape the product. In one role you get product, customer discovery, customer success, customer coordination and a taste of engineering.

This role is on site in New York, where all of our customers are.

What you’ll do

- Work directly with doctors, practice managers and clinic staff to understand their workflows and pain points

- Run customer discovery: gather requirements, spot patterns across practices, and turn them into clear product priorities

- Help design the product with the founders and engineers, and test new features with customers

- Onboard new practices: coordinate setup, access, integrations and training

- Drive usage: track adoption, find out why users stall, and get more doctors using the product more often

- Be the single point of contact for customers, and close the loop on every issue and request

- Work with engineers to debug problems, write specs, and ship small fixes yourself where you can

- Help with early sales and renewals by building trust and relationships with practices

Ideal candidate

- Genuinely wants to start a company someday and wants a front-row seat

- Strong communicator who is comfortable talking with doctors and busy clinic staff

- Highly organized, follows through, and closes loops

- Energized by ambiguity and takes ownership without needing to be guided

- Based in New York, or willing to move, and comfortable being on site with customers most days

- Comfortable with technology, and curious about how software gets built

- New Grads welcome to apply

Nice to have

- Prior experience in customer success, consulting, startups, product or operations

- Familiarity with healthcare, practice operations or EMR systems

- Basic technical skills such as SQL, scripting or working with APIs

- Prior founder or founding team experience

What you get

- Direct, daily work with the founders, plus exposure to board and investor conversations

- A broad view of product, customers, sales and engineering that few roles offer

- Real ownership, with scope that grows as the company does

- Support on your path to starting your own company

- Competitive salary

title: Recruiter
description:

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY
Due to continued growth, we are seeking a motivated Recruiter to join our recruitment team.
This is an opportunity for an early-career recruiter, HR graduate, or people-focused professional to learn full-cycle recruitment while supporting searches for clients across multiple industries and countries. We are particularly interested in candidates with some sourcing or recruitment-coordination experience, but we will also consider strong graduates and career changers who show curiosity, persistence, and great communication skills.
The position is fully remote and works alongside senior recruiters, with hands-on training in sourcing, screening, candidate outreach, and AI-assisted recruitment tools.
RESPONSIBILITIES

• Source candidates through LinkedIn, Indeed, job boards, referrals, and the internal database.

• Write and post job advertisements in line with client requirements and company standards.

• Screen resumes and conduct initial phone or video interviews to assess fit, availability, and compensation expectations.

• Reach out to passive candidates with personalized messages and follow-ups.

• Coordinate interview schedules between candidates, clients, and hiring managers.

• Maintain accurate candidate records, notes, and pipeline status in the ATS and recruiting trackers.

• Prepare candidate profiles and shortlists for review by senior recruiters.

• Keep candidates informed and engaged throughout the hiring process.

• Support offer, reference-check, and onboarding paperwork as needed.

• Track daily and weekly activity metrics such as outreach, screens, and submittals.

QUALIFICATIONS

• 0-2 years of experience in recruitment, HR, sales, customer service, or a related people-facing role.

• Recent graduates and career changers are encouraged to apply.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

• Comfortable making calls and reaching out to people you don't know.

• Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail.

• Basic proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.

• Ability to learn new tools quickly, including ATS platforms and AI-assisted recruitment tools.

• Professional discretion with candidate and client information.

• Reliable internet connection and a quiet home workspace; flexibility to work across client time zones.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

• Sourcing on LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, or similar platforms.

• Using an applicant tracking system (ATS) or recruiting CRM.

• Agency or staffing-firm recruitment.

• Recruiting for US or international clients across time zones.

• High-volume, technical, or skilled-trades hiring.

• Using AI tools to support sourcing, outreach, or job-description writing.

WHY JOIN US?

• Join a growing recruitment team that is investing in its people.

• Work fully remote while learning full-cycle recruitment from experienced recruiters with international client backgrounds.

• Build hands-on skills with modern sourcing and AI-assisted recruitment tools.

• Grow through daily micro-learning sessions and on-the-job coaching.

• Receive competitive compensation with a clear path to Senior Recruiter roles.

title: Solutions Architect, NYC
description:
ABOUT EXA

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

Solutions Architects are the technical tip of the spear in Exa's presales motion. From the first call to the technical win, you're the person who shows prospects what Exa can do and proves it works for their use case. You partner with Account Executives on new accounts and new opportunities, and you're measured on technical wins, POC conversion, and pipeline velocity.

You'll run discovery with engineers and executives, build demos that land, design and run workshops and proofs of concept, and make the technical case for Exa against alternatives. When a deal needs specialist depth, you pull in our Forward Deployed Engineers. When a deal closes, you hand the customer off to them with everything they need to get to production fast. This is not a demo-only role. You are an engineer who sells.

 

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Lead the technical side of new opportunities alongside Account Executives, from first call through technical win

- Run discovery to understand a prospect's use case, architecture, data needs, and success criteria, and qualify where Exa fits

- Build and deliver tailored demos, sample apps, and prototypes that show what Exa can do on the prospect's own problem

- Design and run workshops and POCs with clear success criteria, timelines, and evaluation plans, then drive them to a decision

- Win technical evaluations by benchmarking Exa on quality, latency, and cost, and making a clear case against alternatives

- Handle technical objections and answer security, compliance, and architecture questions

- Bring in Forward Deployed Engineers as specialists when a deal needs deeper expertise, and run a clean handoff to them after close

- Feed market signal back to Product: what prospects ask for, where we lose, and what would help us win

- Build reusable presales assets such as demo environments, reference architectures, and evaluation playbooks

REQUIREMENTS

- Several years of hands-on programming experience. You can build compelling demos, implement POCs end to end, and design and run rigorous evals in head-to-head competitive scenarios

- 2+ years of hands-on presales or technical sales experience, ideally at an AI-native or developer-first company. You've owned the technical side of deals, run discovery and demos with technical buyers, and helped carry opportunities to close

- Strong communication skills: you can adapt your pitch to CTOs, engineers, and PMs alike, and explain complex technology simply

- Track record of high performance in demanding environments, whether that's a top CS program, a competitive sport, a startup, or something else entirely

- High tolerance for context-switching, ambiguity, and sustained intensity

- Willingness to travel as needed for customer meetings and workshops

- Have worked as a solutions architect, solutions engineer, or sales engineer at a developer-tools, API, or AI company

- Have built with LLMs, RAG, or agents and can talk credibly about retrieval and search quality

- Have helped close revenue or driven commercial outcomes at a previous company

- Thrive in early-stage environments where your job description changes monthly

- Love the moment a prospect sees a demo and gets it

title: Senior Benefits Program Manager, APJ
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

The Role

As the Senior Benefits Program Manager for Asia-Pacific and Japan (APJ), you will lead the regional design, strategy, and compliance of our benefit and wellness programs across 10+ countries, with a primary focus on India. Reporting to the Head of Global Benefits, you will navigate an evolving legislative landscape-including India’s Labor Codes and APJ statutory updates-to build scalable, competitive rewards. You will balance long-term strategic planning with operational excellence, serving as our regional subject matter expert to support international business growth.

What You’ll Do

• Regional Strategy & Legislative Governance: Lead end-to-end program design, evaluation, and statutory compliance across APJ, proactively translating complex regional legislative changes (e.g., India Labor Codes, data privacy, statutory leave, and pension updates) into risk-mitigated benefit policies.

• Benefits Renewals & Financial Partnership: Manage the full lifecycle of benefit program renewals across the region, partnering efficiently with Finance and Procurement on budgeting, contract execution, purchase orders, and monthly invoice processing/reconciliation.

• Shared Services & Operations Transition: Drive the operational transition of benefits processes from the Center of Excellence (COE) to Global Shared Services, establishing clear documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and training programs for HR Operations to seamlessly take over day-to-day administration.

• Vendor & Financial Optimization: Own regional broker relationships, execute complex multi-country RFPs and contract negotiations, and lead long-term financial modeling, budgeting, and cost-impact analyses for health, welfare, and retirement plans.

• Process & Technology Architecture: Partner with HRIT, Payroll, and Finance to design, automate, and scale benefits administration workflows within Workday and local benefit platforms across the APJ region.

• Cross-Functional Executive Leadership: Formulate and present executive-level business cases and strategic benefit proposals to senior leadership, while serving as the primary escalation point for complex employee inquiries.

What You’ll Bring

• APJ Benefits & Statutory Expertise: Demonstrated experience owning and executing multi-country employee benefit programs across the Asia-Pacific and Japan region, including direct experience navigating India’s statutory compliance frameworks, retirement schemes, and health/risk benefits.

• Strategic Vendor & RFP Management: Proven experience managing regional broker relationships, leading end-to-end RFP processes, and negotiating multi-country vendor contracts and service level agreements.

• HR Systems & Operational Automation: Hands-on experience scaling benefits administration through enterprise HRIS (such as Workday) or local benefit administration tools, including building automated workflows and data controls.

• Executive Communication & Influence: Experience building data-driven business cases, presenting strategic rewards proposals to senior executive stakeholders, and partnering with cross-functional partners in Legal, Payroll, and Finance.

• Reliable remote-work setup and stable internet.

Nice To Have

• Experience with Intercom or HubSpot.

• Prior remote work experience with North American, UK, European, or Australian customers.

• AMER shift: 5:00 PM to 1:00 AM UTC, which is 1:00 AM to 9:00 AM PHT.

USD $1,000 to $1,300 per month, based on experience and fit.

This is a chance to join a growing global support function at an important moment. The company is building a stronger Level 1 and Level 2 support model, and strong performers may have opportunities to grow as the team scales.

You will support customers doing meaningful work in their communities, and your work will directly affect whether they can use their systems confidently and efficiently.

Qualified candidates will complete a video interview with Urrly . The strongest candidates may also complete a practical assessment focused on written communication, attention to detail, and customer-support judgment.

title: Field Product Quality Engineer - Altius
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Field Product Quality Engineering team operates at the intersection of flight operations and mission success for Anduril’s autonomous aerial systems. We ensure that every anomaly, failure, and performance trend is captured in real time and driven to root cause resolution-so that each flight makes the next one more reliable.

This is a field-forward role. You will be on-site at launch and recovery locations, working shoulder-to-shoulder with flight crews, systems engineers, and program leadership to close the loop between what happens in the air and what gets fixed on the ground.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Flight Operations Quality Data Collection

• Work under minimal supervision with responsibilities for test planning, execution, reporting, and evaluation of the aircraft system under test (software and/or hardware).

• Manage all field configuration changes-hardware, software, and as-shipped main box contents. Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, Mission Performance, Design, Software, and Configuration Management to maintain clear as-built records in support of root cause corrective actions and customer complaints.

• Develop and maintain standardized field data collection protocols, checklists, and digital forms that ensure consistent, high-fidelity quality records across all flight events and operational sites.

• Perform real-time quality observation during launch sequences, in-flight operations, and post-flight recovery-identifying workmanship issues, procedural deviations, configuration discrepancies, and environmental factors that may affect flight performance or vehicle integrity.

• Establish, track, and analyze key quality metrics-first-flight success rate, recurring anomaly trends, pre-flight escape rate, and mean time between failures-to provide the product team with actionable reliability data.

Flight Failure Investigation & Corrective Action

• Own the end-to-end coordination of all flight failures-from initial data collection and evidence preservation through root cause analysis, corrective action implementation, and effectiveness verification. Initiate rapid “In the Field” 8D analysis to establish quick wins that enable return to flight.

• Lead cross-functional failure review boards with flight operations, systems engineering, manufacturing, and reliability engineering to determine root cause using structured methodologies (8D, 5-Why, Fishbone, Fault Tree Analysis).

• Coordinate rapid containment actions following flight anomalies, including fleet-wide inspections, hold/release decisions, and risk assessments to determine return-to-flight readiness.

• Monitor a flight failure tracking system with full traceability from symptom to root cause to corrective action closure; generate trend reports and lessons-learned summaries for program leadership.

• Interface with design engineering and upstream manufacturing/supplier quality to translate field failure findings into actionable design changes, drawing updates, supplier corrective actions (SCARs), and process improvements that prevent recurrence across the fleet.

Product Quality & Continuous Improvement

• Support Material Review Board (MRB) activities for field-discovered nonconformances, providing disposition recommendations inf

Leidos is a Fortune 500® company with nearly $18B in sales and 50,000 employees that brings over 70 years of experience in support of both investor-owned and municipal utility growth goals. Your greatest work is ahead!

We are looking for a SOC Experience Lead to lead and enhance our SOC (System and Organization Controls) practice, with a focus on SOC 1 and SOC 2 engagements. Why Join RS Assurance & Advisory?

• Direct impact on the development and expansion of RSAA's SOC services.

• Work with a diverse range of organizations across different industries.

• Collaborative and remote-first working environment.

title: Analista de datos
description:

En general su función está ligada a toda la integración y generación de los datos Latam, requiere la identificación y trabajo en tendencias, modelos que se pueden generar a través de la data, ejemplo optimización de precios, indicadores de desempeño etc., eventualmente se van a optimizar esos indicadores de desempeño a partir de la data, no solo desde el procesamiento de datos si no también desde el análisis y generación de valor desde el rol como analista.
